jobs.title: Corporate Development Manager
jobs.description:
Founded in 1920, Eastman is a global specialty materials company that produces a broad range of products found in items people use every day. With the purpose of enhancing the quality of life in a material way, Eastman works with customers to deliver innovative products and solutions while maintaining a commitment to safety and sustainability. The company’s innovation-driven growth model takes advantage of world-class technology platforms, deep customer engagement, and differentiated application development to grow its leading positions in attractive end markets such as transportation, building and construction, and consumables. As a globally inclusive company, Eastman employs approximately 13,000 people around the world and serves customers in more than 100 countries. The company had 2025 revenue of approximately $8.8 billion and is headquartered in Kingsport, Tennessee, USA. For more information, visit  www.eastman.com .

Responsibilities

This is an office-based position located at Eastman’s corporate headquarters in Kingsport, Tennessee.

•    Collaborate with global, cross-functional deal teams supporting mergers and acquisitions and other strategic initiatives.
•    Work with internal stakeholders to develop and maintain a pipeline of potential corporate development opportunities aligned with Eastman’s strategic priorities.
•    Analyze the external environment, including industry structure, demand drivers, competitors, customers, market trends, and other relevant factors.
•    Evaluate internal capabilities, including technologies, people, products, and business platforms, to support strategic assessments.
•    Develop and own financial analyses, Excel-based models, valuation analyses, forecasts, scenarios, and business cases to evaluate strategic alternatives.
•    Apply appropriate modeling and valuation techniques, including discounted cash flow, comparable company and transaction analysis, accretion and dilution, return analysis, and other relevant methods.
•    Develop insights, analyses, and recommendations and communicate them through clear, accurate, and high-quality presentation materials.
•    Present findings and recommendations to project teams, business and functional stakeholders, and management to support alignment and decision-making.
•    Coordinate assigned project activities, including work plans, timelines, action tracking, information gathering, status updates, and issue resolution.
•    Support due diligence activities by coordinating information requests, organizing findings, identifying issues, and preparing internal due diligence updates.
•    Support integration planning and other transaction-related activities in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
•    Work with target companies, advisors, investment bankers, and other external service providers as appropriate and under the direction of the deal lead.
•    Assist with transaction negotiations and other deal execution activities as assigned.
•    Serve as a resource to teammates by sharing knowledge, analytical approaches, and best practices related to corporate development activities.
•    Lead smaller projects or workstreams with manageable risk and resource requirements.
•    Work collaboratively across the global Eastman organization to support successful project and transaction outcomes.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

•    Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university required.
•    Five or more years of relevant experience in corporate development, investment banking, private equity, consulting, internal corporate strategy, finance, accounting, or a related business function. Equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered.
•    Demonstrated experience using Excel for financial modeling, analysis, forecasting, valuation, or business case development.
•    Demonstrated project management experience coordinating work across multiple stakeholders, functions, or business areas.
•    Demonstrated experience contributing to alignment and advancing strategic or business projects with cross-functional stakeholders.
•    Corporate finance or accounting coursework required through formal education or an applicable job training program.

Occasional travel may be required based on business and transaction needs.

Eastman is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a highly engaged workforce, where everyone can contribute to their fullest potential each day.

jobs.title: Marine Operations Manager EMEA
jobs.description:
Job overview

Eastman is a global specialty materials company headquartered in Kingsport, Tennessee, USA, with approximately 13,000 employees serving customers in more than 100 countries. In 2025, the company generated revenue of around $8.8 billion. Committed to improving the quality of life in a material way, Eastman works collaboratively with customers to deliver innovative products and solutions, with a strong focus on safety and sustainability. To support our global operations and ensure the reliability of our supply chain, we are currently looking for a Logistics Operations Manager, Marine – EMEA.
As Logistics Operations Manager, Marine (EMEA) at Eastman, you play a vital role in successfully exporting our products across the globe. Reporting directly to the EMEA Logistics Manager, you lead a dedicated team of five professionals and drive all marine logistics operations (ocean shipments) across the EMEA region, ensuring our export flows are safe, efficient, and delivered on budget.
You balance day-to-day operational execution with long-term strategy. You work closely with our 4PL partner and ocean carriers to keep them sharp on quality, cost, and reliability. You serve as the primary escalation point for operational disruptions and continuously drive improvements in both internal and external processes, collaborating closely with Supply Chain, Procurement, Customer Service, and manufacturing sites.

Key responsibilities

•    Lead, coach, and develop the EMEA marine operations team of five direct reports, creating clear accountabilities and fostering a high-performance culture.
•    Oversee day-to-day operational delivery of all ocean export shipments from the EMEA region, ensuring high levels of delivery reliability, customer satisfaction, safety, and quality — all within budget.
•    Drive performance management of the 4PL partner and ocean carriers by implementing KPIs, conducting regular performance reviews, and supporting annual RFP initiatives.
•    Initiate, lead, and implement process improvement projects that drive efficiency, digitalization, and cost optimization across the marine logistics supply chain.
•    Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders (Supply Chain, Procurement, Manufacturing Sites, Customer Service) and external partners, serving as the escalation point for operational incidents and crisis management.
•    Translate procurement and logistics strategies into operational KPIs, dashboards, and action plans, and cascade strategic targets into clear team objectives.

What you bring

•    Bachelor's degree required, Master's degree preferred in Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, or a related field.
•    Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in logistics or supply chain, with proven expertise in marine logistics (ocean freight). Experience in the chemical industry or a similarly regulated environment is strongly preferred.
•    A people-focused leader with a demonstrated track record of coaching, developing, and building high-performing teams.
•    Experience managing complex logistics service providers (e.g., 4PL partners) and carrier relationships.
•    Strong track record in operational excellence, SOP development, safety, compliance, and supplier management.
•    Experience with SAP or similar ERP systems; strong MS Office skills.
•    Certifications such as APICS, Lean Six Sigma, or CPIM are a plus.
•    Fluent in English (verbal and written); Dutch is a plus.
•    Personal attributes: high accountability, excellent communicator, collaborative, decisive under pressure, strong relationship management and influencing skills, ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced environment.

Why choose Eastman?

•    A full-time permanent position in the chemical industry
•    A varied role within a great team, with room for your own input and ideas.
•    An engaging, innovative environment where growth, learning, and taking initiative are actively encouraged.
•    A dynamic, internationally oriented multinational with an open culture and collegial atmosphere.
•    An attractive salary and benefits package in line with the chemical industry, including meal and eco-vouchers, a representation allowance, a strong bonus system, and a 'flexible income plan'.
•    Flexible working hours with the possibility of working from home one day per week. A generous leave arrangement — in addition to the statutory 20 days, you are entitled to 18 additional days through working time reduction, plus seniority days
•    A market-leading package of collective insurance: hospitalization insurance, outpatient insurance, pension plan, private accident insurance, and more.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager - AMI
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

The Business Development Manager is responsible for executing Eastman’s Advanced Materials Interlayer business strategy with a specific focus on automotive original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) in China. The role identifies and develops new specifications by engaging OEM technical and development teams early in the buying process, understanding customer needs, and guiding solutions through evaluation and adoption. The position works closely with Account Managers, Integrated Account Teams, laminators, and selected technology suppliers to support customer success and guide opportunities toward adoption. Approximately 50% or more travel is required, primarily within China.

Responsibilities

-

-

- Build a growth pipeline aligned with Eastman’s automotive strategy by engaging priority automotive OEMs in China and their technical, development, and advanced materials teams.

- Identify early-stage opportunities, understand customer needs and decision-making processes, and influence specifications and material-selection decisions by demonstrating the value of Eastman’s solutions.

- Use market, customer, and competitive intelligence to identify new opportunities and strengthen Eastman’s position across the automotive value chain.

- Enter opportunities into SF.COM, coordinate with Integrated Account Teams to advance them through the Opportunity Management System, and ensure the appropriate internal resources support timely progress toward adoption.

- Develop strong relationships with key stakeholders across OEMs and other value-chain suppliers, where needed.

- Map decision-makers, introduce new product innovations, monitor technology and market trends, and explore relevant collaboration opportunities.

- Protect existing programs and work closely with Account Managers and Account Representatives to convert qualified opportunities into sales and support a smooth transition through commercialization.

Qualifications

Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university required; master’s degree or PhD preferred.

- Five to ten years of advanced sales or business-development experience within the automotive industry.

- Extensive knowledge of automotive markets, OEMs, customers, and value-chain dynamics in China.

- Experience in market strategy, customer strategy, strategic planning, specification development, and influencing complex buying processes.

- Experience with SF.COM, CRM platforms, Opportunity Management processes, and other sales systems and tools.

- Ability to collaborate effectively across functions, build credibility with senior customer stakeholders, and operate in a technically complex, multi-stage sales environment.

- Fluency in Mandarin and English advantageous for this China-focused role.

Description

The Sourcing Manager will lead strategic sourcing for multiple categories, the initial/primary focus may include bulk tank terminals, isotanks, surveyors, drayage and freight forwarders. The scope and breadth of this position may evolve as business needs change, and the role may be asked to support other transportation modes as needed. This position will develop market insights and deliver total-cost-of-ownership (TCO) reductions while maintaining supplier service levels. A strong understanding of chemical terminals and/or isotank shipping is preferred.

This is an individual contributor position part of a large marine organization.

Responsibilities

- Commercial leverage to achieve best cost and service outcome for responsible Categories

- Assess and address category risk

- Implement and develop mitigation and contingency plans

- Work closely with key stakeholders, ensure alignment with Business, Logistics Operations Technology, and Manufacturing stakeholder needs, and develop effective category strategies and implementation plans

- Develop and maintain deep market insights and expertise into assigned categories

- Must be familiar with overseeing sourcing strategy, development, and execution

- Drive sustainable procurement and risk management objectives

- Oversee process to select suppliers and own relationship and performance

- Negotiate and execute contracts in line with the product and category strategies

- Collaboration with key business and functional partners to ensure alignment of strategies with business needs

- Measure and track internal performance within each spend category

- Drive annual productivity improvements in each spend category

- Collaboration with Marine Operations and distribution safety to qualify new vendors

- Balance commercial and sustainable aspects to make sourcing decisions aligned with company and business strategies

- Conduct strategic RFPs, supplier evaluations, and bid analyses as needed

- Partner with Legal to ensure alignment with corporate standards and compliance requirements.

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business or related field required

- Master’s degree a plus

- 2+ years experience required; 5+ years of experience preferred either within Procurement or similar commercial experience.

- Experience with Chemical Terminals or Marine modes strongly preferred

- Chemical industry experience strongly preferred

- Negotiation experience with customers or suppliers

- E-procurement tool experience preferred (Coupa, Ariba, etc.)

- Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data analysis, cost modeling, and market research

- Logistics operations background is preferred

jobs.description:

The company had 2025 revenue of approximately $8.8 billion and is headquartered in Kingsport, Tennessee, USA. For more information, visit  www.eastman.com .
Description

The Innovation Marketing Manager helps build Eastman's next generation of growth by translating market shifts, unmet customer needs, and technology capabilities into scalable business opportunities. This role operates at the front end of innovation, identifying and evaluating new growth opportunities, developing business cases, and advancing the most promising concepts through the company's innovation and Stage-Gate processes.

The successful candidate combines strategic marketing expertise, customer insight, commercial judgment, and cross-functional leadership. Working closely with technical, business, commercial, sustainability, manufacturing, and other functional teams, this individual will help determine where Eastman should invest, how new offerings can create differentiated value, and what is required to bring those opportunities to market.

Responsibilities

Identify and Prioritize Growth Opportunities
Identify emerging growth opportunities by analyzing market trends, customer needs, technology developments, and industry dynamics.
Evaluate and prioritize a portfolio of ideas, recommending which opportunities should be advanced, refined, pivoted, or discontinued.
Apply structured innovation methods and frameworks to assess strategic fit, market attractiveness, customer value, differentiation, commercial potential, and risk.

Lead Customer and Market Discovery
Conduct customer discovery and voice-of-customer research to uncover unmet needs and validate market opportunities.
Design and execute primary and secondary market research to address critical knowledge gaps.
Perform market, competitive, regulatory, industry, value-chain, and trend assessments to identify opportunities and challenges.

Build Business Cases and Value Propositions
Develop compelling value propositions that clearly articulate customer benefits and competitive differentiation relative to alternative solutions.
Build fact-based business cases by evaluating market size, adoption potential, revenue potential, economics, key assumptions, risks, and competitive dynamics.
Identify critical assumptions, potential barriers, and risks early, and develop plans to validate or mitigate them.
Develop preliminary market entry, commercialization, and activation strategies for selected opportunities.

Lead Innovation Projects
Lead the marketing workstream for growth opportunities from early discovery through concept development and advancement within Eastman's innovation and Stage-Gate processes.
Use structured market and business evaluation frameworks, including Eastman's EBME approach, to support high-quality strategic choices.
Collaborate with technical, commercial, sustainability, manufacturing, business, and other functional partners to develop opportunity strategies and commercialization plans.
Provide clear recommendations based on customer, market, competitive, and business insights.

Influence and Align Stakeholders
Build strong relationships with customers, external partners, and internal stakeholders to foster a market-centric approach to innovation.
Communicate complex ideas and recommendations through clear, compelling presentations and business cases.
Facilitate alignment and gain stakeholder commitment at key decision points throughout the front-end innovation and Stage-Gate processes.
Influence across functions without direct authority and constructively challenge assumptions to improve decisions.

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Engineering, Science, or a related discipline.

- Five or more years of relevant experience in strategic marketing, business development, product management, innovation, commercial leadership, or a related field.

- Applicable industry experience is preferred.

- Customer-facing, commercial, or business development experience.

- Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

- Experience conducting market research, customer discovery, and voice-of-customer activities.

- Experience developing value propositions, opportunity assessments, business cases, and commercial recommendations.

- Strong analytical, communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.

- Demonstrated ability to convert incomplete information into clear recommendations and operate effectively in ambiguous, rapidly evolving environments.

Preferred Qualifications

- MBA or advanced degree.

- Experience with innovation management, front-end innovation, Stage-Gate, or similar business development processes.

- Experience advancing new products, services, technologies, applications, or business opportunities from early discovery through commercialization.

- Experience with market segmentation, targeting, portfolio management, market mapping, and strategic planning.

- Experience developing financial models and assessing the commercial viability of new opportunities.

- Experience in B2B, specialty materials, chemicals, advanced manufacturing, or another technology-driven environment.

Desired Leadership Competencies

- Strategic thinker with strong business acumen and commercial judgment.

- Customer-focused, insight-driven, and intellectually curious.

- Entrepreneurial and comfortable making recommendations with incomplete information.

- Skilled at influencing, facilitating decisions, and building alignment across functions.

- A clear communicator who can engage both technical and business audiences.

- Results-oriented, with the ability to move opportunities from idea to action.

Description

The Sourcing Manager role is a full-time position in the Indirect Strategic Sourcing organization, based in Kingsport, TN, reporting to the Manager of Strategic Sourcing for Indirect Services. The Sourcing Manager for Site Services is responsible for developing and executing sourcing and category strategies that optimize total cost of ownership, contractor performance, safety, operational reliability, and business continuity across Eastman’s site services spend portfolio.

This role manages strategic supplier relationships, leads competitive sourcing events, negotiates service agreements, and oversees the contract lifecycle from sourcing strategy through renewal or transition. The Sourcing Manager partners closely with Maintenance, Engineering, Operations, Reliability, Finance, Legal, Insurance and Risk, and other stakeholders to ensure that service providers meet Eastman’s technical, safety, quality, compliance, and performance expectations.

The ideal candidate is proactive, commercially skilled, and relationship-oriented, with strong business acumen and an understanding of category management, contractor services, and service agreements. The successful candidate will be able to influence stakeholders, lead through ambiguity, and balance short-term operational needs with long-term value, supply resilience, and risk management.

Responsibilities

- Develop and lead comprehensive sourcing and category strategies for site service categories such as mechanical services, inspection services, plant maintenance support, and other contractor-provided services.

- Analyze spend, market conditions, supplier capabilities, labor availability, cost drivers, and operational requirements to identify opportunities for cost savings, cost avoidance, process improvement, and value creation.

- Conduct total cost of ownership, should-cost, benchmarking, and other commercial analyses to support sourcing decisions and negotiations.

- Lead sourcing events, including requirements development, supplier prequalification, RFPs, supplier evaluations, bid analysis, negotiations, and award recommendations.

- Evaluate suppliers based on commercial value, technical capability, safety performance, quality, capacity, workforce availability, financial stability, compliance, and ability to support Eastman’s operational requirements.

- Manage the contract lifecycle, including contract negotiation and execution, performance monitoring, amendments, renewals, competitive reviews, and transition or exit planning.

- Lead supplier business reviews and continuous improvement initiatives. When necessary, collaborate with the internal stakeholders to address performance issues, coordinate corrective-action plans, and negotiate appropriate remedies when supplier performance does not meet expectations.

- Partner with Maintenance, Engineering, Reliability, Operations, and site leadership to understand business requirements, define scopes of work, establish service expectations, and align sourcing strategies with operational priorities.

- Track and report savings, supplier performance, contract coverage, sourcing pipeline activity, risk, and other category management metrics.

- Ensure compliance with sourcing policies, procurement governance, ethical business practices, contract requirements, and operational controls.

- Build effective relationships with internal stakeholders and strategic suppliers while promoting fair, objective, and well-documented sourcing processes.

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, or a related field.

- At least three years of related experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, supply management, commercial management, contract management, or a comparable business role.

- Strong commercial judgment and negotiation skills, with the ability to optimize total cost of ownership while considering safety, quality, reliability, risk, and supply continuity.

- Experience developing and executing sourcing strategies, leading RFPs, evaluating suppliers, analyzing bids, and making sourcing recommendations.

- Experience with supplier performance management and contract lifecycle management.

- Strong analytical skills, including proficiency in spend analysis, cost modeling, data interpretation, market research, and business-case development.

- Ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders and suppliers at multiple organizational levels.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Strong organization, attention to detail, follow-through, and accountability.

- Proactive and self-motivated approach to recognizing needs, anticipating issues, solving problems, and developing practical solutions.

- Ability to adapt to changing business priorities and work effectively in a complex operational environment.

Preferred:

-

- Experience sourcing contractor services, craft labor, maintenance services, or other industrial site services.

- Experience working in a manufacturing, chemical, energy, refining, mining, utilities, or other industrial environment.

- Experience managing multi-site, regional, or global service providers.

- Experience with alternative commercial models, including time-and-materials, unit rates, fixed-price work, reimbursable cost structures, performance-based agreements, and master service agreements.

Familiarity with e-procurement, source-to-contract, contract management, and enterprise resource planning systems such as SAP, Ariba, Coupa, or similar platforms.

jobs.title: Capital Procurement Manager
jobs.description:
Founded in 1920, Eastman is a global specialty materials company that produces a broad range of products found in items people use every day. With the purpose of enhancing the quality of life in a material way, Eastman works with customers to deliver innovative products and solutions while maintaining a commitment to safety and sustainability. The company’s innovation-driven growth model takes advantage of world-class technology platforms, deep customer engagement, and differentiated application development to grow its leading positions in attractive end markets such as transportation, building and construction, and consumables. As a globally inclusive company, Eastman employs approximately 13,000 people around the world and serves customers in more than 100 countries. The company had 2025 revenue of approximately $8.8 billion and is headquartered in Kingsport, Tennessee, USA. For more information, visit  www.eastman.com .
Description

The Capital Procurement Manager leads procurement planning and execution for assigned capital projects across Eastman’s capital project portfolio. The role partners with project managers, engineering, construction, legal, and other stakeholders to develop procurement approaches that support project scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, and risk objectives.

The position contributes from early project definition through contract award and execution, helping identify market and schedule constraints, develop competitive sourcing strategies, obtain reliable cost information, and secure the equipment, materials, and services required by the project. The manager applies relevant Eastman category strategies, sourcing agreements, and approved supplier lists where appropriate, while developing project-specific approaches when the project’s needs or market conditions warrant them.

Success requires sound commercial judgment, strong planning and follow-through, and the ability to influence project teams and suppliers in a complex, changing environment. The role balances total project value with schedule, technical suitability, supplier capability, quality, safety, and commercial risk.

The ideal candidate is proactive, commercially skilled, and relationship-oriented, with strong business acumen and an understanding of project management, contractor services, and service agreements. The successful candidate will be able to influence stakeholders, lead through ambiguity, and balance short-term operational needs with long-term value, supply resilience, and risk management.

Responsibilities

•    Develop procurement plans for assigned capital projects, documenting the sourcing approach, procurement packages, supplier strategy, contracting plan, key decisions, and schedule requirements.
•    Partner with project managers and engineering teams to translate project scope and technical requirements into procurement packages and a coordinated procurement schedule. Identify long-lead items, critical-path constraints, market capacity issues, and other procurement risks early enough to support mitigation.
•    Engage during project definition and early engineering, including FEL 1 and FEL 2, to provide market insight, budgetary pricing, supplier input, contracting considerations, and cost-reduction options. Support procurement readiness for FEL 3 and final project appropriation estimates.
•    Develop and execute sourcing events for equipment, materials, engineering services, construction services, and other project needs. Prepare or coordinate bid packages, supplier lists, bid slates, commercial evaluations, negotiations, and award recommendations in partnership with technical and project stakeholders.
•    Assess supplier capability and commercial proposals in light of project requirements, including delivery capacity, schedule commitments, technical fit, quality, safety, financial and execution risks, and relevant supplier performance.
•    Negotiate contracts and commercial terms for project purchases and services, including scope, pricing, delivery, payment, performance obligations, change management, and appropriate risk provisions. Coordinate review of deviations from standard terms with Legal and other relevant functions.
•    Coordinate procurement activities with capital buyers and other procurement resources assigned to projects to support timely purchase orders, supplier commitments, expediting, and issue resolution.
•    Monitor procurement risks and commitments throughout project execution. Partner with the project team and suppliers to address delivery, quality, commercial, scope, and contract issues, and develop practical recovery or mitigation actions.

Success in This Role

Success in this role means delivering strong commercial value while protecting safety, schedule, quality, and contractor performance. It requires objective, evidence-based judgment; the confidence to respectfully challenge assumptions or recommendations when warranted; and the ability to influence stakeholders toward fair, transparent decisions that best serve business needs - even when those decisions are difficult or unpopular.
Key outcomes include effective contract lifecycle management, well-designed and competitively conducted sourcing events, validated savings and cost avoidance, strong contractor performance, reduced supply and contractor risk, and effective stakeholder and supplier relationships.
